description_en: Call ListSkillGroupsOfUser to obtain the list of skill groups to which an agent belongs
description_zh: 调用ListSkillGroupsOfUser获取坐席所归属的技能组列表
name: ListSkillGroupsOfUser

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user whose skill group list you want to obtain.

Note that this is the unique identifier of the RAM sub-account in the call center instance, not the RamId, but the UUID
parameters.help_zh:
待获取技能组列表的用户ID。

注意这里是RAM子账号在呼叫中心实例的唯一标识并非RamId，即UUID
parameters.name: user_id

SkillLevel.description_en: The list of skill groups to which the user belongs
SkillLevel.description_zh: 用户所属的技能组列表

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the call center instance to which the skill group belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 技能组所归属的呼叫中心实例ID

PhoneNumber.description_en: The phone numbers used by the skill group for making outbound calls and whether outbound calls are allowed
PhoneNumber.description_zh: 技能组能否拨打外线以及拨打外线时所使用的电话号码

AllowOutbound.description_en: Indicates whether outbound calls are allowed. The value depends on: 1) carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls. 2) Call center instance settings. Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) configure the carrier settings so that users hear a prompt tone when calling the number, or 2) unbind the number from contact flows (IVR). However, this is not recommended by ACC
AllowOutbound.description_zh: 是否允许外呼，结果取决于1）大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼 2）呼叫中心实例的设置。电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不绑定联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

City.description_en: The city to which the number belongs

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the call center instance to which the phone number belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 电话号码所归属的呼叫中心实例ID

PhoneNumberDescription.description_en: A brief description of the phone number

PhoneNumberId.description_en: The phone number ID, which is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
PhoneNumberId.description_zh: 电话号码ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

Province.description_en: The province to which the number belongs

RemainingTime.description_en: The remaining call time for the test number. Unit: minutes
RemainingTime.description_zh: 测试号码剩余的通话时间。单位为分钟

TestOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the number is a test number

Trunks.description_en: The number of trunks for the phone number, which indicates the number of concurrent calls it can support. The data is obtained from the carrier
Trunks.description_zh: 电话号码的中继数量，即可同时支持几路通话，数据来源于大于

Usage.description_en: The usage of the phone number, which can be inbound, outbound, or bidirectional. Valid values: Inbound, Outbound, and Bidirection. These values are defined by the PhoneNumberType enumeration. The value depends on: 1) carrier settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls. 2) Call center instance settings. Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) configure the carrier settings so that users hear a prompt tone when calling the number, or 2) unbind the number from contact flows (IVR). However, this is not recommended by ACC
Usage.description_zh: 电话号码的用途，呼入，呼出，已经同时用于呼入和呼出。 Inbound, Outbound, Bidirection。上述值由枚举类型PhoneNumberType定义。该值的结果取决于1）大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼 2）呼叫中心实例的设置。电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不连接人和联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

SkillGroupDescription.description_en: A brief description of the skill group
SkillGroupDescription.example: 售后技术支持人员使用

SkillGroupId.description_en: The unique ID of the skill group, which is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
SkillGroupId.description_zh: 技能组唯一ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

SkillGroupName.description_en: The name of the skill group, which must be unique within the call center instance to which it belongs
SkillGroupName.description_zh: 技能组名字，需要在所归属的呼叫中心实例中唯一

SkillLevelId.description_en: The unique ID of the skill level, which is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
SkillLevelId.description_zh: 技能级别唯一ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
